steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Holy ****! Is the Tide of Ashes that basic? It comes at the drop of a hat?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I don't think this Tide of Ashes formed naturally.
You follow the direction of Hecate's finger. Aboard the desert bandit ship, the desert bandit boss is holding up the red-glowing crystal, as if conducting some ritual.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The Ash Crystal... can form a Tide of Ashes?!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We can ponder the mechanics of it later. If we want to get out of here alive or stop the Ash Crystal, we must seize their Ash Crystal first!
After analyzing the map with Kawa-kawa, you order the rest of the V-710 crew to encircle the battlefield from both sides, aiming to corner the desert bandit ship.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The opponents can't be difficult to deal with.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: Hahahahaha!
However, the desert bandit boss is unfazed by the siege. He roars at you with bloodshot eyes.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: You think I'm afraid of you DisCity lapdogs?! You know very well what the people of WhiteSands have been through!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: You monopolized Hypercubes to reap vast fortunes from WhiteSands, but you don't give a damn whether the people of WhiteSands live or die!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: It was me! I brought together all the persecuted people of WhiteSands, bestowed upon them Hypercubes and gave them the hope to live!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What lies!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Your actions are clearly pushing unarmed civilians into the abyss!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You think DisCity doesn't know about your plot?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You want to stir up trouble and sow discord, plunging more WhiteSands civilians into misery! You want DisCity to build more shelters!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: After all, it's much easier to raid civilian shelters than Hypercube freighters with formidable defenses!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: Shut up! Shut your filthy pie-hole!
The enraged desert bandit boss swings his sword at you, only to be blocked by Hella. The savage clash of metal sets off fiery sparks.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Crap crap crap! My hand is numb! What kind of sword is that?!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: Hehehe... did you think I had no chance of winning?
The desert bandit's strength troubles you... He is not Manic, yet he has enough power to fight Sinners in a way that no ordinary person could.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella! Be careful!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahhh! Thank goodness I dodged quickly! That speed and strength is incredible!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are you sure that guy isn't a Sinner or Corruptor? Hecate and I couldn't beat him with our combined strength!

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Not right now, but he will become one.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: He prayed to the Ash Crystal for power and received an answer. He has been bestowed the power of limbo, plunging him into paranoia and rage.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Just like the shadowy figures whose souls have been devoured by the Tide of Ashes, it is only a matter of time before he becomes a Corruptor.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: You dare... compare me to those lowly monsters...?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Aww, Miss Stargazer, your words really shattered his little heart!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: Soon you won't dare to speak with such insolence... hehehe...

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: I shall use the power bestowed upon me by the Ash Crystal to smite you, to smite DisCity, and obtain all the Hypercubes...

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: By then, I shall control everything in WhiteSands! I shall become the master of WhiteSands!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: Hahahahaha... ahhhh...!
His arrogant cackles suddenly become pained whimpers as Stargazer looms before the desert bandit boss.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: How humans hate and kill each other is of no consequence to me at all.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: But if you presume to use your tedious barbarism to mistreat and desecrate WhiteSands... That is unforgivable.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: O desecrator of WhiteSands, the only place your soul deserves to be is Hell.
The desert bandit boss locks his glare onto Stargazer.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: If... I... die... then... you... shall... also...
Black shadows entangle and smite the desert bandit boss, who stops breathing before he can spit out his last words.

With a flick of her hand, Stargazer flings the desert bandit who had been jeering arrogantly just moments ago like a rag doll into the desert. The white sands devour him immediately, leaving not even a single bone behind.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, we didn't find any Ash Crystals on the ship. They must have been moved.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The Tide of Ashes is approaching the shelter. We need to retreat to the V-710.

As soon as you return to the V-710, you receive word that the Outland Affairs Bureau has learned of the desert bandit boss's death. They also know the Ash Crystal is still at large, and demand you to immediately continue pursuing the remaining desert bandits to retrieve it.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Can't we wait a little longer? There are still a lot of people in the shelter who haven't had the chance to board.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: So what? Your mission is to chase down the desert bandits and retrieve the Ash Crystal! Not wasting time on rescue efforts!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I can't turn a blind eye to those in need.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Pfff, you say this because you want to obstruct the mission, don't you?! Only a Quinn lackey would give such a ridiculous reason!

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: You're just a navigator. You're not qualified to engage in our talks.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: MBCC Chief, you're a smart cookie who knows what you need to do, right?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Did the Outland Affairs Bureau activate an emergency response to deal with the impending Tide of Ashes at the shelter? Are rescue measures being taken?

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Are you trying to teach me what measures to take?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm not trying to teach you. I'm asking you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Or does the Chief of the Outland Affairs Bureau regard the lives and property of Outland civilians in WhiteSands as of little concern?

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: You...!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you indeed hold these views, I don't think there is any need to listen to your comms anymore.
You shut off the comms.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wow, ${PlayerName}, that was so cool! See, Hecate, I told you not to stop me! No one can handle listening to that old fart!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: ...Impressive! So this is the real Chief?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, what shall we do now?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hecate, arrange for those in the shelter to board the ship. Hella, do a head count and make sure no one is left behind.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Kawa-kawa, monitor the movement of the Tide of Ashes and report any updates.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No matter what happens, our priority is to save lives! All consequences...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: There's no time.
After uttering these icy words, Stargazer turns to the raging Tide of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: At this speed... there's no time! There's simply no time to evacuate them!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: If we don't leave now, we'll get caught up in it too...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The desert bandits who took the Ash Crystal must be back. They don't intend to spare anyone here!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, shall we leave?
Leave? After issuing such a riveting speech, how can you watch these innocent people perish because of your actions?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: However, there is another foolproof way, and that is to use an Ash Crystal.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: It can drive away sandworms and pierce through ashes, for it is a creation born from the Tide of Ashes, and the infallible treasure of the desert bandits.
You remember the dead Ash Crystal.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Kawa-kawa, open the vault.
You change your mind. The mission must be completed, but the people must be saved, too. You are ready to trust your decision and trust... Stargazer.
You decide to gamble on the abilities and wisdom of Stargazer to open a path for you. Even if you are condemned as a "heretic" afterwards, you are willing to bet that she will be on your side.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Give the Ash Crystal to Stargazer

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Try and see if you can reactivate it.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I was right about you. You are indeed a brave one.
Stargazer flashes an inscrutable smile and takes the Ash Crystal from your hand. However, she does not let go of your hand, leading you onto the deck with her.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Stay with me, MBCC Chief. I need you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Use your shackles to help me.
You obey her words and begin casting the power of the shackles into the dead crystal alongside her. Thanks to your efforts, the dull gray crystal begins to glow with luster.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Did... did we succeed?
Stargazer's hands glow red as she guides you to raise up the Ash Crystal, her gaze reverent, as if whispering to the stars...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: "Scatter, depart, wallow, don't look back, don't look back..."
The moment the Tide of Ashes touches you, it dissolves into starry patches of light, scattering to the wind across WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I can't believe it... this actually made the Tide of Ashes disappear!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, the obstacle has been removed. It's time to close the net.
